|lore='''Leader''' of a Tusken Raider tribe. Unafraid of machines. Skilled hunter and marksman. Raids moisture farms for water. Roams the Jundland Wastes in search of unwary travelers.
|game_text=Deploys only on Tatooine. While another Tusken here, opponent's weapon destiny draws here are -2 and once per turn, may place a card from hand on top of your Force Pile to draw top card of Reserve Deck. Other Tuskens here are forfeit +4.

|notes=Set 8 was released 24 November 2004. [https://web.archive.org/web/20041204170841id_/http://www.swccgpc.com/interior.htm Release announcement]. The 2005 publication changes deploy and forfeit to 3 and 4, qualifies the weapon penalty and card exchange on another Tusken, and specifies other Tuskens in a separate forfeit sentence. The remaster prints all three functions under its opening Tusken Raider qualifier.  The dated replacement survives as issuer text. These images depict the later remaster: [[:File:Holotable-OVS8-URoRRuR-R-R-v17.gif|Holotable-OVS8-URoRRuR-R-R-v17.gif]], [[:File:OVS8-46-URoRRuR_R_R-remaster.webp|OVS8-46-URoRRuR_R_R-remaster.webp]], [[:File:VS8O-46-URoRRuRRR.png|VS8O-46-URoRRuRRR.png]].
